baseline_models.focus_anchor: The opening arrival of the promise and the closing description of it as effected.
baseline_models.mechanism: A bounded promise reaches its appointed threshold, becomes present, and is converted from prior speech into an accomplished event.

activation_trace.role: Literal coming and occurrence make the promised event become present rather than remain verbal.
A promise bounded by time or place supplies the due threshold announced by the conditional opening.
Occurrence and presence in time locate the closing statement in realized history.
The production of an act makes the final participle certify execution rather than expectation.

changed_reading.before: A threat or promise is merely recalled.
changed_reading.after: The verse depicts a scheduled word crossing its due threshold into completed execution.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: We raised and sent against you servants belonging to Us, possessors of severe force.
baseline_models.mechanism: The force is formidable but not autonomous: it is stirred, directed, and related to the sender as an instrument under command.

activation_trace.role: Sending and directing a delegate supplies the command vector that moves the force toward its target.
Bondage and possession mark belonging to the sender, making the agents subordinate rather than self-authorizing.
Overpowering severity supplies the agents' effective coercive capacity.
Hard strength and solidity intensify the force into one capable of overcoming resistance.

changed_reading.after: A severe but subordinate force is deliberately commissioned and aimed as the means by which the promise is enacted.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: They moved through the intervals of the dwellings.
baseline_models.mechanism: The action crosses the settlement boundary and repeatedly traverses its internal connective spaces, combining roaming, searching, and physical contact with inhabited space.

activation_trace.role: Roaming repeatedly among dwellings makes the incursion interior and distributed rather than a strike at the perimeter.
Exhaustive searching adds an investigative reach into what the dwellings contain.
Gaps and passages between things provide the spatial channels through which the agents spread.
Residence and affiliation with a house make the traversed field domestic and inhabited, not empty terrain.

changed_reading.after: They penetrate the settlement's connective interior and search through its inhabited domestic fabric.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The promise is explicitly the first of a pair.
baseline_models.mechanism: Priority language makes the event an opening phase whose meaning is structurally incomplete without a later phase, even before that later phase is supplied.

activation_trace.role: Beginning and precedence mark this fulfillment as the leading member of an ordered sequence.
One thing following another without a break supplies a latent sequential relation beyond the first event.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports an isolated punitive episode.
changed_reading.after: The episode is the opening movement of an explicitly ordered pair.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same servant category spans the carried night servant, the grateful servant, the armed servants in the focus, and servants whose sins are known. This makes servanthood primarily a relation of subordination to God; the label alone does not settle every bearer's moral profile.

activation_trace.role: Possession and subordination make the focus agents belong to the commissioning power.
Submissive service marks the singular night traveler as a positively framed servant.
Submissive service joins Noah's identity to gratitude and supplies the exemplary end of the category.
Recognition and praise of beneficence explicitly qualify that servant, showing that moral praise is separately stated.
Possession extends the servant designation to a population whose conduct remains under judgment.
Sin attached to servants prevents the category itself from functioning as an automatic declaration of righteousness.

structural_cues: The servant noun recurs before and after 17:5 with explicit positive qualification in 17:3 and explicit sins in 17:17.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one relational label across morally differentiated contexts; I infer that the focus label first marks belonging and commission. A live alternative is that the focus agents are also positively obedient even though that evaluation is not carried by the noun alone.

changed_reading.before: Servants of Ours necessarily identifies the invading force as morally exemplary.
changed_reading.after: The phrase securely marks divine ownership and commission, while the agents' complete moral status remains a separate question.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding decree identifies repeated corruption and domineering elevation; the focus then converts that prior determination into a countervailing force that enters the offenders' own spatial interior.

activation_trace.role: A threat specializing in harm supplies the punitive potential that the context gives a cause.
A cutting judgment supplies the authoritative determination that precedes execution.
Departure from sound order supplies the breach to which the focus action responds.
Domineering self-elevation supplies the vertical excess that the dispatched force counterbalances.

structural_cues: 17:4 places decree, doubled corruption, and great elevation immediately before the conditional arrival in 17:5.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a decree plus corruption and domineering elevation; I supply the causal arrow from that breach to the dispatched counterforce. A live alternative is that 17:4 predicts chronology without fully explaining the agents' function.

changed_reading.before: The promised attack arrives as an unexplained calamity.
changed_reading.after: The attack is staged as the enacted counterforce of a prior decree against systemic corruption and domineering elevation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Restoration after the first blow, a later matching promise, and the formula of return for return convert the focus from one item in a list into one state transition within a reversible feedback cycle.

activation_trace.role: Beginning and precedence identify the focus as the cycle's first marked phase.
Return to a former position reverses the direction established by the first incursion.
A renewed turn after an earlier turn gives the restoration a counterstroke structure.
Laterness names the matched second phase against which the first phase is read.
Return after departure appears on both sides of the clause and turns recurrence into reciprocal response.

structural_cues: The sequence runs from first promise to restored turn, later promise, and the paired condition if you return, We return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reversal, a later phase, and reciprocal return; I infer a feedback mechanism in which conduct reactivates consequence. A live alternative is a closed two-episode chronology with no broader repeatability.

changed_reading.before: The first promise is simply earlier than the second.
changed_reading.after: The first promise initiates a reversible cycle in which restoration remains conditional and renewed conduct can reactivate renewed consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The first traversal of dwellings and the later entry into the sanctuary form matched penetrations: private inhabited space is breached first, then public sacred space, followed by dismantling of what had risen.

activation_trace.role: Distributed roaming within dwellings supplies the first episode's interior ingress.
Passages between things define the connective interior penetrated in the first phase.
Literal entry into an interior supplies the second phase's corresponding breach of the sanctuary.
A temporal occurrence and repetition explicitly recall an earlier entry as the template.
Breaking and nullifying extend the second ingress from penetration to systematic dismantling.

structural_cues: 17:7 repeats the arrival-of-the-promise formula and explicitly compares the later entry with the first entry.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lexical and syntactic mirroring; I infer that the later sacred-space entry reveals the first domestic traversal as a designed counterpart. A live alternative is that the repeated formula only distinguishes two events without making their spaces functionally comparable.

changed_reading.before: Roaming through dwellings is incidental battlefield movement.
changed_reading.after: The domestic traversal is the first half of a paired architecture of ingress, later mirrored by entry into the sanctuary and dismantling.

context_deltas.mechanism: Human haste is followed by the measured alternation of night and day, the counting of years, and reckoning. This activates the focus promise as timed administration rather than impulsive retaliation.

activation_trace.role: The split-root image of counted time and recurrence makes the promise available as a scheduled interval.
Haste and premature advancement supply the human temporal disorder against which the promise's timing is contrasted.
Explicit enumeration supplies measurable sequence rather than an unmarked delay.
Counting and reckoning make time administratively legible and support a due, accountable fulfillment.

structural_cues: The hasty human of 17:11 is followed by night-day signs, counted years, and reckoning in 17:12.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies haste beside calibrated time; I infer that this contrast characterizes the focus fulfillment as measured rather than reactive. A live alternative is that the temporal instruction is general and does not specifically qualify the first promise.

changed_reading.before: The severe response can sound like sudden retaliatory impulse.
changed_reading.after: Its arrival belongs to a measured and countable schedule that contrasts with human haste.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context places a personal record and nontransferable burden before the rule that punishment follows a dispatched messenger. Read back into the focus, the dispatched force is the enforcement end of a notice-record-accountability sequence, not a cancellation of individual responsibility.

activation_trace.role: Directed dispatch supplies the enforcement movement at the focus end of the sequence.
Binding a judgment to a person supplies individualized attachment of consequence.
A written determination that establishes judgment turns conduct into an inspectable record.
A heavy burden borne by its owner prevents blame from being transferred wholesale between persons.
Dispatch before punishment supplies the prior-notice stage parallel to, but distinct from, the focus dispatch.
Messenger and message identify what the earlier dispatch carries: disclosure before enforcement.

structural_cues: 17:13-15 moves from each person's attached record to nontransferable burden and then to no punishment before a messenger is sent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies personal accounting and messenger-before-punishment; I infer an ordered pipeline from disclosure to record to enforcement around 17:5. A live alternative is that the general rule is satisfied elsewhere and does not specify the mechanics of this particular episode.

changed_reading.before: A plural population is exposed to an undifferentiated collective penalty.
changed_reading.after: The public incursion remains a corporate event, but blame is individually recorded and nontransferable, with enforcement presupposing prior disclosure.

context_deltas.mechanism: A city is presented as a gathered social body whose internal elite transgression makes the word binding and leads to comprehensive ruin. This sharpens the focus traversal of dwellings into propagation through a civic network once a threshold is crossed.

activation_trace.role: Household residence supplies the inhabited units through which the public consequence propagates.
People gathered as a town supply the civic whole composed of the focus dwellings.
A binding due obligation marks the threshold at which the declared word becomes enforceable.
Comprehensive ruin supplies the terminal civic outcome toward which interior penetration can escalate.

structural_cues: 17:16 orders city, affluent command, transgression, binding word, and destruction as a causal sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a threshold sequence at city scale; I infer that the house-by-house movement in 17:5 is how a civic judgment reaches the settlement's constituent units. A live alternative is that 17:16 gives a general pattern rather than an explanatory replay of 17:5.

changed_reading.before: The dwellings are merely the scenery of a raid.
changed_reading.after: The dwellings are the constituent nodes of a civic order through which a binding public consequence propagates.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later context says worldly extension and gift reach both immediate and ultimate seekers without being barred. Material capacity or historical deployment therefore need not equal final approval; the focus agents can be real instruments without their commission alone deciding their ultimate rank.

activation_trace.role: Belonging and subordination establish instrumentality while leaving final evaluation unstated.
Directed sending identifies a function performed in history, not by itself a complete moral verdict.
Connected increase and support extend capacity to both contrasted groups in the verse.
Giving and handing over supply worldly resources without making receipt identical to approval.
The negated image of barring makes the worldly grant broadly available rather than a selective certificate of favor.

structural_cues: 17:18-20 contrasts seekers of the immediate and the hereafter, then explicitly extends provision to both these and those.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies worldly extension to morally divergent aims; I infer that effective deployment in 17:5 proves commission and capacity but not necessarily final endorsement. A live alternative is that these particular agents are positively approved on grounds beyond the generic servant designation.

changed_reading.before: Being sent and empowered proves the agents' complete moral endorsement.
changed_reading.after: Their deployment proves instrumentality under divine command; worldly effectiveness and ultimate moral rank remain distinguishable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because military roaming is the immediate spatial sense, but exhaustive searching remains a direct focus branch and is activated by the later written record and knowledge of hidden conduct. Render it as an audit-like secondary dimension of the incursion, not as a replacement for physical force.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The verb of moving through the dwellings also carries exhaustive searching.

activation_trace.role: Searching a place exhaustively turns traversal into invasive discovery of what its interior contains.
An organized written object supplies the later audit record against which searching can be heard.
Knowledge of reports and inner realities supplies the epistemic endpoint of the search image.

changed_reading.before: The agents merely move through urban space.
changed_reading.after: Their physical penetration also carries an audit-like exposure of what the domestic interior contains.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because the construction is plainly spatial, yet the same focus root explicitly carries defect and weakness, while corruption immediately precedes the incursion. Preserve it as a structural analogy in which moral-political failure opens routes for penetration; do not translate the spatial expression as corruption.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The agents move through the kh-l-l of the dwellings.

activation_trace.role: Defect and weakness in an order turn the literal gaps into a secondary image of exploitable structural fissures.
Repeated interior traversal supplies the movement that exploits and spreads through those fissures.
Departure from soundness supplies the contextual condition that makes structural weakness legible.

changed_reading.before: The gaps are only alleys or spaces between houses.
changed_reading.after: The physical passages also figure the weaknesses opened within a corrupted civic order, through which the counterforce can spread.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation is surprising and form-distant because it uses non-dominant packet mappings of the promise root into counted time and annual alternation. It remains packet-anchored and gains support from explicit return and counted years; render it only as a cadence or seasonal analogy, never as the lexical definition of promise.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The promise root is repeated at the opening threshold and closing fulfillment.

activation_trace.role: Counted time that recurs at known intervals supplies a periodic cadence for the promised event.
Alternating annual bearing and nonbearing supplies a material image of gain and loss in successive turns.
Reciprocal return after departure activates the possibility of recurrence rather than a single exhausted event.
Recurrent counted time ties the exploratory cadence to the context's explicit temporal accounting.

changed_reading.before: First and later promises are only two ordinal dates.
changed_reading.after: They can additionally be heard, with strong qualification, as counted turns in a historical season of loss, restoration, and possible return.

strongest_changes: The fulfilled promise becomes the enacted counterforce of the preceding decree against corruption and domineering elevation.
The first incursion becomes one phase in a reciprocal cycle, spatially mirrored by the later entry into the sanctuary.
Servanthood marks divine relation and commission more securely than it guarantees the agents' complete moral profile.
Corporate penetration of dwellings is bounded by prior disclosure, personal record, and nontransferable burden.
summary.what_was_special: The focus binds timed fulfillment, commissioned force, and interior penetration. Context turns those into a feedback mechanism, while non-dominant mappings preserve exploratory signals of counted recurrence, audit-like search, and structural fissure.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the focus agents are positively approved beyond the secure sense of belonging and commission.
How far exhaustive searching can carry an audit dimension without eclipsing the immediate military action.
Whether the counted and alternating split-root mappings are active semantic resonances or only useful formal prompts.
How directly the generic city-destruction sequence in 17:16 explains the particular first promise in 17:5.
